facts.fact: The Direction Générale des Impôts FAQ says taxpayers are registered in the registre des contribuables or the software for Identifiants financiers uniques (IFU), and that salaried users can use the eSintax platform to file declarations.
facts.system: Identifiant financier unique (IFU) logiciel / registre des contribuables

facts.fact: The Direction Générale des Impôts FAQ says customs clearance procedures linked to foreign trade cannot be carried out without an IFU, the single number issued to users of the financial administration.

systems.system: Identifiant financier unique (IFU) logiciel / registre des contribuables
